root_cause: The first provenance revision checked market observation timestamps against the data cutoff but did not require the source snapshot itself to have been captured by that cutoff. A later-retrieved or revised historical snapshot could therefore contain a timestamp-valid observation that was not actually available to the model at forecast time. Feature snapshot metadata was also hash-bound but not semantically compared with the bytes.
corrections: Every observation in a price snapshot must be no later than the snapshot capture time.
Issue-price snapshots must have been captured no later than data_cutoff_utc.
Outcome-price snapshots must have been captured no later than the system-recorded outcome time, while the selected observation remains the latest one at or before target_end_at_utc.
Feature snapshot bytes must match record_type, source_id, snapshot_id and captured_at_utc metadata, be captured no later than the forecast cutoff, and contain a non-empty features mapping.
Metrics authorization revalidates price-snapshot availability and feature-snapshot semantics from hash-verified bytes.
tests_added: Reject issue price snapshots captured after the data cutoff.
Reject price observations later than the snapshot's capture time.
Reject feature snapshot bytes whose identity disagrees with forecast metadata.
Reject outcome price snapshots captured after the system outcome-recording time.
data_policy: Historical replay forecasts are eligible for evaluation only when their source snapshots themselves are point-in-time captures no later than the recorded data cutoff. Later backfilled snapshots cannot silently masquerade as point-in-time inputs.
